name: Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad
overview: 今年 Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad 没有发布涉及业务板块扩张、新增、缩减、出售或获得合约的公告；已发布的公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会、年报及股息除权安排。
overview_en: This year, Alliance Bank Malaysia Berhad did not announce any business segment expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins; its announcements were mainly quarterly results, general meetings, annual report, and dividend book closure arrangements.
